history: The story of Cayman Super Kings began with a vision shared by a few passionate individuals who believed that cricket could bring together a unique community on the Cayman Islands. Before COVID-19 changed the world, Gopal, Majin Paul, Christopher Balraj and Kiruba had already envisioned building a team made up of individuals who had moved to the Cayman Islands to pursue careers, build new lives, and grow professionally—but who also shared a deep love for cricket. In 2022, Cayman Super Kings was officially founded. Led in its formative years by Christopher Balraj and then captained by Rahul Garg, with Majin Paul as the team backbone and manager, CSK has grown into a premier contender, qualifying for the 2025 T10 tournament knockouts and seeing players represent Cayman on international stages.

honours.title: T10 Tournament Knockout Stage Qualifiers
honours.description: Historic milestone qualification under the captaincy of Rahul Garg.

honours.title: International T10 League Representation
honours.description: Rahul Garg and Christopher Balraj competing with global cricket icons (David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, Alex Hales, Shakib Al Hasan).

honours.title: ICC World Cup Qualifier Representative
honours.description: Christopher Balraj selected for Cayman Islands national team in Bermuda.

honours.title: National Team Training Squad Selections
honours.description: Rahul Garg and Gokul Krishnan selected for Cayman Islands national training pool.

timeline.title: A Vision Conceived
timeline.description: Gopal, Majin Paul, Christopher Balraj, and Kiruba envision a competitive leather-ball team for professionals in Grand Cayman.

timeline.title: The Birth of CSK
timeline.description: Cayman Super Kings is officially founded under the leadership of Christopher Balraj; Rahul Garg joins late 2022.

timeline.title: Tournament Debut & World Cup Qualifier
timeline.description: CSK plays its first competitive tournament. Christopher Balraj travels to Bermuda for the ICC World Cup Qualifiers.

timeline.title: Captaincy Handover & International T10
timeline.description: Rahul Garg takes over captaincy; Rahul represents CSK in international T10 leagues playing with David Warner and Alex Hales.

timeline.title: T10 Knockouts & Dual T10 Selection
timeline.description: CSK reaches T10 tournament knockouts. Chris Balraj and Rahul Garg compete in international T10; Rahul and Gokul join National Training Squad.

timeline.title: Youth Pathway & Championship Run
timeline.description: Mentoring school cricketers, developing the next generation, and contending for championship honours.

leadership.name: Rahul Garg
leadership.bio: Opening batsman, medium pacer, and captain who led CSK to the 2025 T10 knockout stages.

leadership.name: Majin Paul
leadership.bio: The backbone of CSK, keeping the squad united on and off the field since before COVID.

leadership.name: Christopher Balraj
leadership.bio: Inaugural captain, Cayman international in Bermuda 2023, and premier leg-spin all-rounder.

ground.name: Jimmy Powell Oval
ground.location: West Bay Road / George Town, Grand Cayman
ground.facilities: Two-bay net practice enclosures, pavilion & clubhouse, spectator seating, floodlight training bays.
